t: A tiny, low-cost Linux board with a display port and a real-time helper core.
steps: Buy a Lyra, Lyra B, or Lyra Plus from Luckfox or Waveshare.
Get a microSD card, as the base Lyra boots only from microSD.
Download the Buildroot image from the Luckfox wiki.
Flash the image to the card with the flashing tool the wiki names.
Power the board over USB-C and log in over the serial or network connection.
Blink the user LED from the shell as your first test.
Try the wiki's Qt GUI guide with a Raspberry Pi DSI screen.
